input_commit_note: The private commit the skill text and the program came from. It is not reachable from this repository, so it records provenance for the author and is not something a reader can verify.

agent.note: No agent session invoked the skill to produce this evidence. The program was run directly from a shell while this release was being prepared.

invocation.working_directory: a copy of skills/ and examples/ outside the repository

output.note: The file is the capture, byte for byte. The capture wrapper wrote each command line before running it and wrote the exit status line from the program's exit status; everything between those lines is the program's standard output.
